title: 把主进程启动路径上的同步 I/O 移出首帧

originalAcceptance.criterion: 启动 trace 能定位每次 >5ms 的主进程同步阻塞；窗口创建前无可解释的长同步 I/O
evidence: loadExtensionsFromManifest now uses fs/promises readFile; no readFileSync manifest parse remains.
Before/after 5-run marks retain app-ready, window-created, ready-to-show and renderer-first-paint; all runs have complete mark sets.
The gateway-start mark is present after ready-to-show in 5/5 after runs, so config-sync starts after the first-frame signal.

originalAcceptance.criterion: 目录扫描、prelaunch maintenance 和大 manifest 读取改为异步或首帧后执行；保留必要的原子写入语义
evidence: launch-at-startup synchronization moved from awaited pre-window path to the deferred window-services block.
Gateway config-sync directory scans and Docker spawnSync remain in the existing config-sync implementation, but execute only after the ready-to-show-gated gateway start.

originalAcceptance.criterion: config-sync 的 Docker spawnSync 不在窗口首帧前执行，或记录明确的阻断理由
evidence: after results gateway-start after ready-to-show: [True, True, True, True, True]
The marker is emitted immediately before the deferred gateway auto-start; config-sync runs inside that start path.

originalAcceptance.criterion: 主进程启动前后 CPU 采样与启动 marks 成对落盘，证明没有把阻塞转移到 renderer
evidence: before sampler avg CPU samples=[28.33, 24.36, 26.18, 23.76, 24.38]; after=[26.56, 30.62, 21.24, 23.74, 26.85]; each run produced one real sampler sample and renderer-first-paint mark.
renderer-first-paint P50=26.099999994039536→25.099999994039536ms; no consistent transfer to renderer is evidenced.

gates.command: portable Node 24.16.0 + @playwright/test cli: main-navigation, settings-storage, gateway-lifecycle

boundaries: Short-run CPU sampling produces one real sample per run; this is not a long CPU curve or release benchmark.
P50/P95 startup variance is retained; this node claims removal of pre-first-frame blocking work, not a universal latency percentage.
Renderer first-paint P95 is noisy across five fresh processes; no synthetic smoothing or warm-up exclusion was applied.
All evidence is local, agent-driven, and contains no real-human verdict.
